skill.name: when-reviewing-code-comprehensively-use-code-review-assistant
skill.description: Comprehensive pull request review using specialized agents for security, performance, style, tests, and documentation.
skill.summary: Coordinates multi-agent pull request review and merge readiness checks.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: Most static findings were false positives caused by Markdown fences, example tables, and review criteria. I confirmed the generated auto-fix shell script risk and added semantic findings for npx-based package execution and repository-modifying auto-fixes. No prompt injection text was found.

remediation.issue: Remote package execution through npx commands
remediation.suggestion: Pin package versions, document network execution, and require user confirmation before running npx or npm tools.

remediation.issue: Auto-fix script can modify repository files from generated paths
remediation.suggestion: Add dry-run mode, validate paths stay inside the repository, and replace command substitution with a safe line-reading loop.

remediation.issue: Executable examples are mixed with documentation
remediation.suggestion: Mark examples as optional, require review before execution, and separate report examples from runnable scripts.

semantic_findings.title: Remote Package Execution Through npx
semantic_findings.description: The skill directs agents to run npx commands, including claude-flow@alpha and other tooling, which can download and execute package code. This requires explicit confirmation, version pinning, and a trusted environment.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited sections explicitly instruct use of npx and npm commands during review setup and execution. The risk is contextual package execution, not a scanner-only pattern.

semantic_findings.title: Auto-Fix Script Modifies Repository Files
semantic_findings.description: The generated auto-fix script runs formatters, uses sed to edit configuration, and creates test files from a generated list. These operations can change source files and should require dry-run review and path validation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited script block directly shows repository-modifying commands and file creation. The risk depends on user approval and path hygiene, so medium severity is appropriate.

content.value_statement: Large pull requests are hard to review consistently across security, performance, tests, and documentation. This skill coordinates specialized review agents and produces merge readiness feedback.
actual_capabilities: Orchestrates specialized review tracks for security, performance, style, tests, and documentation.

Produces merge readiness scoring across review dimensions.

Review command execution and generated scripts before allowing file changes.

faq.question: Does this skill replace human code review?
faq.answer: No. It organizes checks and findings, but maintainers should verify results before approving a pull request.

faq.question: Which tools does it expect?
faq.answer: Examples include ESLint, npm audit, gitleaks, coverage tooling, bundle analysis, and project review scripts.

faq.question: Can it modify files?
faq.answer: Yes, the auto-fix examples can modify files. Review commands first and use source control.

faq.question: Is it suitable for CI?
faq.answer: Yes, it includes CI-style merge readiness checks. Pin dependencies and require approval for risky commands.

faq.question: What review dimensions are covered?
faq.answer: It covers security, performance, code style, test coverage, test quality, and documentation completeness.

faq.question: Does it need project configuration?
faq.answer: Yes. It assumes the repository has matching scripts, test commands, lint rules, and security tool configuration.
